name: DominoPost – Advanced Post Editor
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPost transforms your WordPress editing experience with a comprehensive suite of tools designed for content creators, bloggers, and publishers. Version 2.0.0 introduces advanced content management features that help you maintain fresh, organized, and engaging content.

🚀 Core Editor Features

Modern Table of Contents
* Auto-generate TOC from post headings
* 4 beautiful style variations (Bullets, Numbers, Minimal, Boxed)
* Show/Hide toggle for visitors
* Smooth scrolling to sections
* Customizable default visibility and position

Title Case Fixer
* Quick title formatting with one click
* Sentence case, UPPERCASE, lowercase, Capitalized Case
* Convenient “Aa” button next to post title
* Instant preview and apply

Enhanced Code Blocks
* Beautiful styled code blocks
* One-click copy functionality
* Syntax highlighting support
* Custom titles/labels

Table Generator
* Create professional tables easily
* Responsive design
* Modern styling included

Emoji Picker
* 75 curated emojis for bloggers
* Checkmarks, arrows, bullets, and symbols
* Common expressions and useful icons
* One-click insertion

Download Buttons
* Attractive animated download buttons (pulse, bounce, glow)
* Auto-add https:// to URLs without protocol
* Open in new tab option
* Left, center, or right alignment
* Perfect for files, ebooks, resources

Find & Replace
* Search and replace text in editor
* Case-sensitive option
* Regex support
* Saves time on bulk edits

📚 Content Management Features (v2.0.0)

Related Posts
* Automatically display related content
* Smart matching by tags, categories, or keywords
* Simple numbered list design
* Manual selection option via meta box
* Shortcode: [dominopost_related]
* Example: Keep readers engaged with “More Articles on this topic”

Update Reminders
* Dashboard notifications for posts needing review
* Set custom reminder dates
* “Notified” button marks content as updated
* “Remind me 2 days later” button for postponing
* “Last Updated” badge display option
* Mark posts as “evergreen” (no reminders)
* Example: Get notified when tutorials need updating

📊 Content Analysis

Real-time Content Analyzer
* Word count
* Character count
* Reading time estimate
* Top 5 keywords
* Readability score
* Refresh on demand

⚙️ Settings & Customization

  • Centralized settings page
  • Configure all features from one place
  • Per-post overrides available
  • No coding required

Usage Examples

Example 1: Keeping Content Fresh with Update Reminders

You’re maintaining a “WordPress Tutorial” that needs quarterly updates:

  1. Write your comprehensive tutorial
  2. In the Update Reminder meta box, set next review to 90 days from now
  3. Publish your post
  4. After 90 days, see dashboard notification: “Content needs update: WordPress Tutorial”
  5. Click Notified to mark as updated (sets next reminder to 90 days)
  6. Or click Remind me 2 days later if you need more time

Result: Your content stays fresh with minimal effort!

Example 2: Related Posts for Better Engagement

You have several posts about “WordPress SEO”:

Automatic Method:
1. Go to DominoPost → Settings
2. Enable “Related Posts”
3. Set count to 6 posts
4. Choose matching by “Tags”
5. Save settings

Manual Method (for specific posts):
1. Edit a post
2. Find Related Posts meta box
3. Check 3-5 related articles
4. Save post

Result: At the end of each SEO-related post, readers see a numbered list of related articles, keeping them engaged longer.

Example 3: Professional Code Snippets

You’re sharing PHP code examples:

  1. Select your code in the editor
  2. Click the “Copy Code” button
  3. Enter a title like “functions.php code”
  4. Choose your theme color
  5. Insert

Result: Beautiful, syntax-highlighted code block with a one-click copy button.

Example 4: Table of Contents for Long Articles

You’re writing a comprehensive guide with multiple sections:

  1. Write your article with H2 and H3 headings
  2. Click the TOC button in toolbar
  3. Select which headings to include
  4. Choose a style (Bullets/Numbers/Minimal/Boxed)
  5. Insert at top of content
  6. Publish

Result: Readers get a clickable table of contents with smooth scrolling to sections.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
* Documentation: https://dominopress.com/terms-of-service
* Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/dominopost-advanced-post-editor

Credits

Developed by DominoPress – Making WordPress editing better.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dominopost-advanced-post-editor/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Access settings via DominoPost menu in WordPress admin
  4. Start using the toolbar features in the post editor!
sections.faq:
How do I add a Table of Contents?

Click the TOC button in the editor toolbar. Select your headings, choose a style, and insert. The TOC will automatically update as you edit headings.

Can I customize the TOC appearance?

Yes! Go to DominoPost → Settings and choose from 4 style variations (Bullets, Numbers, Minimal, Boxed). You can also set the default visibility (show/hide) and position.

How do Related Posts work?

Related Posts are automatically displayed at the end of your posts as a simple numbered list based on matching tags, categories, or keywords. You can customize the matching algorithm and number of posts shown in DominoPost → Settings.

You can also manually select related posts by editing individual posts and using the Related Posts meta box in the sidebar.

Shortcode: Use [dominopost_related] anywhere in your content.

How do Update Reminders work?

Update Reminders appear as notifications in your WordPress Dashboard when posts need review:

  1. Edit any post
  2. Find the Update Reminder meta box (right sidebar)
  3. Set a review date
  4. Save the post

When the date arrives, you’ll see a notification on your Dashboard with two buttons:
– Notified – Marks the post as updated and sets the next reminder
– Remind me 2 days later – Hides the notification for 2 days

Can I mark some content as evergreen?

Yes! In the Update Reminder meta box, check “Mark as Evergreen” to disable reminders for specific posts that don’t need regular updates.

How do I manually select Related Posts?

  1. Edit any post
  2. Find the Related Posts meta box in the right sidebar
  3. Check the posts you want to feature
  4. Save the post

If you don’t select any, the plugin will automatically show related posts based on tags/categories.

Does this work with Gutenberg?

DominoPost uses the Classic Editor for a streamlined, distraction-free writing experience. The Classic Editor is automatically enabled when you activate DominoPost.

Will this slow down my site?

No! DominoPost is optimized for performance:
* Frontend CSS/JS only loads when needed
* Minimal database queries
* Efficient algorithms
* No impact on page load times

Can I disable specific features?

Yes! Each feature can be toggled on/off in the settings. You have complete control over which tools you use.
